name: button-group
title: ButtonGroup
description: ONE CONTROL MADE OF MORE THAN ONE PART: buttons welded into a single pill, a menu welded onto the end, or both. The radii flatten where the parts meet and a hairline separates them, because a gap says "two things" — a row of buttons with space between them is a row of buttons, and `<Layout direction="row">` already builds that.
